{{Quote|She's been bleating about the number of men they've committed to this dump. I overheard General Mlaske say she's nagging Zey and Camas to withdraw the garrison and leave the locals to sort themselves out.|Sev|<ref name="O66" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] constructed a '''forward operating base''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]] as a headquarters for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Haurgab|operations]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] backwater [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Haurgab]]. Overseen by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mlaske]], Hadde's forward operating base was home to several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] units, among them members of the [[14th Infantry Brigade]], and at least two [[Company/Legends|companies]] of the [[85th Infantry Brigade]], in addition to the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and [[Omega Squad|Omega]] for the duration of their assignments.

==History==
{{Quote|Hadde Base, this is Omega. Hadde Base, this is Omega. Request immediate extraction. Hadde Base, repeat, this is Omega. We're pinned down at the old Churt fort, twenty klicks southwest of your position. Low ammo, enemy strength estimated at&hellip;between one fifty and two hundred, with cannon and heavy repeaters. No anti-air that we can see. Hadde Base, this is Omega&hellip;|Omega Squad calling Hadde Base for assistance|<ref name="O66" />}}
The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] forward operating base in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]] was constructed approximately [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as a headquarters for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces during their [[Battle of Haurgab|operations]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]], in the midst of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa nine hundred and thirty eight [[Galactic Standard Calendar|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Hadde's [[Forward Command Center/Legends|Forward Operating Base]] was damaged in an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] shelling by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] rebels. Among the losses were a [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relay]], rendering the base unable to receive nor respond to a distress call from the nearby [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]], pinned down by pro-Separatist [[Maujasi]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Only the timely arrival of a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] manned by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[14th Infantry Brigade]] out of the nearby town of [[Neska]]—dispatched by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]], who picked up the distress call when Omega [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]—allowed Omega Squad to escape the fight unharmed and return to Hadde Base.<ref name="O66" />

Thirty-two days later, the base came under attack by a group of pro-Separatist rebels that launched a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] from a house within the Republic-friendly city of Hadde. Striking near the base's [[Cantina/Legends|mess hall]], numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were injured and [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the rocket's explosion and from the subsequent shrapnel. The clone commandos of both [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and Omega [[Squad/Legends|Squads]]—all of whom had been inside the mess at the time of the attack, but were spared the worst injuries due to their hardy [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]]—would lead the counterattack on the Hadde rebels with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and elements of both the 14th and [[85th Infantry Brigade]]s.<ref name="O66" />

==Structure==
The Republic's forward operating base was located on the outskirts of Hadde, and by nine hundred and seventy days into the Clone Wars, had expanded to a size Delta Squad member [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] regarded as approaching a small city in and of itself. The base housed its own [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], along with no fewer than two [[Company/Legends|companies]] of the [[85th Infantry Brigade]] and members of the 14th Infantry [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]] during the Republic's ongoing operations. The sprawling base included a mess hall for dining, [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] for housing clone troops, and the office of the base's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]].<ref name="O66" />
